correctness.rationale: Every ordered edge-pair event is accounted for. The affine map from two distinct adjacent edges to their midpoint has constant Jacobian area/2; the three resulting parallelograms have exact overlap on the medial quarter-area triangle. Same-edge samples give triangular densities on the original sides. Their total mass plus the four planar cells is one. Because every normalized triangle side is strictly below 1/2, the area-minus-midpoint signs are strict on all three corner triangles and opposite on the medial triangle; the boundary is singular positive. These signs give the exact TV Hahn set and formula. Cauchy--Schwarz and an explicit realizable thin-isosceles family establish sharpness. The attached separate barycentric simulator and rational checker ran successfully; it is corroboration rather than an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The distance between iid boundary-endpoint chord midpoints and area-uniform sampling is a canonical and operationally meaningful geometric-probability invariant. The theorem identifies the full singular/absolutely continuous law, gives a geometrically transparent Hahn maximizing set, proves a nonzero universal bias minimum 5/12 with unique equilateral optimizer, and identifies the sharp unattained 1/2 degeneration limit. This supplies a structural extremal answer for arbitrary triangles and an exact benchmark for random-chord sampling methods, rather than a merely numerical case.
